title: New Year Event Staff: Behind the scenes of creating joy through a full Hybrid Event system
image1Description: Controlling video, audio, and streaming systems to connect employees from all branches during the New Year Event

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: The New Year Event is an activity aimed at building relationships and bringing joy to employees throughout the entire corporate group. My intention in the Staff role was to ensure that every employee, whether at the main office or provincial branches, received an equally enjoyable experience through seamless online and on-site systems, ending the year with the most impressive atmosphere possible.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I served as the lead coordinator for the entire Production system, from audio control (Sound Engineer) and managing sound effects and stage lighting to overseeing the Live Streaming. Additionally, I was responsible for 'Virtual Engagement' for online participants. I acted as the Show Runner to ensure that the flow of activities between employees in the studio and those watching online was smooth and consistently engaging.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The main challenge was managing the 'Timing' of the event to be synchronized between on-site and online platforms. This included handling Audio Feedback and solving immediate technical issues to ensure communication between branches remained uninterrupted. Furthermore, it required quick wit to integrate sound effects and lighting that matched the atmosphere of the live stage activities to stimulate excitement and build engagement throughout the event.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: The event was a great success; employees from every branch were able to participate in prize draws and enjoy activities together in real-time. This experience helped me develop 'Broadcasting & Audio Engineering' skills and the ability to manage highly complex Hybrid events. It gave me a profound understanding of the importance of using technology as a bridge to connect people within a large organization.
